predicates.label: belongs to theme
predicates.definition: Places a dataset in exactly one top-level thematic domain of the atlas.

predicates.label: observes
predicates.definition: The environmental property or phenomenon the dataset measures. A dataset may observe several properties; this is the main semantic link and the primary target for model-assisted enrichment.

predicates.label: has analysis concept
predicates.definition: How the dataset is analytically shaped: a state observation, a change series, a risk view, a managed resource system or a mapped feature. Replaces the title regex previously used by the portal.

predicates.label: supports use case
predicates.definition: A decision or workflow the dataset can feed. Drives the portal's 'what can I do with this' surfaces.

predicates.label: covers place
predicates.definition: Geographic area the data actually covers, which is not always the area implied by the title.

predicates.label: related to
predicates.definition: Symmetric association between datasets that are useful together. Populated by similarity search and confirmed by curators.

predicates.label: temporal coverage
predicates.definition: Closed interval of observation as {start, end} years, or a single year for a snapshot.

predicates.label: spatial extent
predicates.definition: Bounding box in EPSG:4326 as [west, south, east, north], measured from the extracted geometry rather than declared.

predicates.label: has distribution
predicates.definition: Links a dataset to one concrete encoding of it: the source package, a document, a web layer or a polygonised raster.

predicates.label: derived from
predicates.definition: Provenance between distributions: which source file a web derivative was produced from. Records the choice the extraction pipeline made.

predicates.label: renders distribution
predicates.definition: Links a browser map layer to the distribution it draws.

predicates.label: has field
predicates.definition: An attribute name present in a vector distribution. Weak but real evidence about what the data contains, and a feature for the enrichment model.

predicates.label: quality flag
predicates.definition: A known defect or caveat, e.g. coverage extending beyond Uzbekistan, or unparseable area values. Kept in the graph so the portal can display caveats instead of hiding them.
